Statements: All cars are vehicles. All vehicles need fuel. Some need diesel.

Conclusions: I. All cars need fuel. II. Some cars need diesel.
questions.explanation: I: Cars ⊂ Vehicles ⊂ fuel-needing ⟹ cars need fuel. TRUE. II: 'Some need diesel' refers to vehicles (subset), not necessarily cars. NOT NECESSARILY TRUE.

questions.stem: Six people sit in a row. P is to the left of Q. Q is 3rd from left. R is to the right of Q. S is between R and T. U is at the right end. The leftmost person is:
questions.explanation: Q at position 3. P left of Q (positions 1 or 2). R right of Q. S between R and T. U at right. Order: P, ?, Q, R, S, T? But U at right. Try: P at 1, ?, Q at 3, R, S, T at 5, U at 6 — 6 positions. So order: P, ?, Q, R, S, U. Who's at 2? Must be from {T}. So: P, T, Q, R, S, U. P leftmost.
questions.subject: REASONING

questions.stem: Which agency coordinates India's cybersecurity response?
questions.passage_context: Cybersecurity has emerged as one of the most critical strategic concerns of the 21st century. As organisations and citizens move ever more activity online, the attack surface for malicious actors expands. Phishing, ransomware, and supply-chain compromise affect everyone from small businesses to national governments. India's CERT-In coordinates response and prevention efforts. Several legislative initiatives — the IT Act, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, and proposed Digital India Act — together form the regulatory backbone. Yet rapidly evolving threat vectors require constant adaptation. Awareness, technical infrastructure, and skilled cybersecurity professionals will all be essential as digital transformation accelerates.
questions.subject: ENGLISH
